The '''J'feh''' were a [[Cephalopod/Legends|cephalopod]]<ref name="Viva Space Vegas" /> [[Species/Legends|species]] characterized by their [[Color/Legends|red]] skin and numerous [[Limb/Legends|tentacles]]. Members of the species usually lived within large, hovering globes.<ref name="DLC" /> [[Skijid Vrescot]] was a J'feh [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] and the [[Count/Legends|Count]] of [[Cheelit/Legends|Cheelit]] who operated on [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]] during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The rubbery-skinned J'feh crossed the [[Glottalphib]] [[Pirate/Legends|piratess]] [[Kliskud]], who ate Vrescot, finding the alien tasty if tough to chew. The J'feh [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Dhol]]<ref name="Viva Space Vegas" /> later occupied the [[Hive Palace]] on Cheelit, and there [[Mission to Cheelit|attempted]] to entrap the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in a game of [[Firepath/Legends|firepath]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], but was incinerated in the game.<ref name="DLC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The J'feh species first appeared in ''[[Dark Lord's Conscience]]'', a comic story written by [[Alan Moore]] and illustrated by [[John Stokes]] and originally released in [[1982]]'s [[The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 155|''The Empire Strikes Back Monthly'' 155]].<ref name="DLC" /> However, the species' name was not given until [[2013]] in [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]]'s [[StarWars.com]] reference article "[[Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel]]."<ref name="Viva Space Vegas" />
